name: Infrastructure and deployment agent
author: ThreatVeil
summary: An agent that can change what runs: the production-approval, read-only boundary and privileged-action claims, and the deployment history observer.

compatibility.note: A repository revision or a desired configuration is never proof of what is running.

dependency_proposals.evidence: The deploy tool's declared approval condition controls the release approval this claim depends on.
The declared read-only condition is the boundary this claim depends on.
The source's declared permission block governs what the agent may change.

observer_requirements.system_of_record: The deployment history of the environment itself
observer_requirements.note: The observed revision must be the one actually serving traffic, not the desired configuration.

limitations: Desired state and readiness never establish exactly what code is running.
Inherited IAM, deny policies and effective access are outside a service-level read.
Claims are declared until an approved executable check with a qualified observer is bound to them.
